Name: Item Bags for Passerby Cemetery
Author: sankayoudead
Description:
This item bag was created for my own playthrough, but maybe someone else will find it useful as well. :) 

[b]Content:[/b]

All-in-One Bag - there were +- 300 objects in the whole expansion and it fits one bag somewhat nicely; it's possible I missed something as I started the playthrough with PC only recently (quest items are removed on purpose) - if that's the case, I'll fix it in the future :) (purchasable at Pierre's)

If you'd prefer the items separately (e.g. Seeds and Saplings, Animal Products and Artisan Goods, ... ), let me know. 

[b]Installation:

[/b]Drop the content of the provided ZIP archive in your Mods folder. 

All credit goes to fellowclown, thank you for the permission the chance to meet Lyell again. It was lovely to see Passerby Cemetery to grow into the expansion it is today. <3
